SmartSqlMap.Select: select top 1 cast(version_id as nvarchar(36)) as version_id, cast(decision_id as nvarchar(36)) as decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time from decision_version where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and version_tag = #{versionTag} order by version_number desc

SmartSqlMap.Insert: insert into decision_version ( version_id, decision_id, decision_key, version_number, version_tag, is_published, is_draft, definition_content, checksum, publish_comment, published_by, published_time, created_by, created_time ) values ( cast(#{versionId} as uniqueidentifier), cast(#{decisionId} as uniqueidentifier), #{decisionKey}, #{versionNumber}, #{versionTag}, #{isPublished}, #{isDraft}, #{definitionContent}, #{checksum}, #{publishComment}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime} )
SmartSqlMap.Update: update decision_version set is_draft = 0 where decision_key = #{decisionKey} and version_id <> cast(#{currentVersionId} as uniqueidentifier) and is_draft = 1
